Angular Button Component Primary Surface Presets Aura Material Lara Nora Ripple RTL v21 v21 v20 v19 v18 v17 FEATURES API THEMING PASSTHROUGH Button Button is an extension to standard button element with icons and theming. Import # import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button'; Basic # Text to display on a button is defined with the label property. Submit Directive # Button can also be used as directive using pButton along with pButtonLabel and pButtonIcon helper directives. Save Link # A button can be rendered as a link when link property is present, while the pButton directive can be applied on an anchor element to style the link as a button. Link Angular Website Router Link Icons # Icon of a button is specified with icon property and position is configured using iconPos attribute. Profile Save Search Update Loading # Busy state is controlled with the loading property. Search Severity # Severity defines the type of button. Primary Secondary Success Info Warn Help Danger Contrast Disabled # When disabled is present, the element cannot be edited and focused. Submit Raised # Raised buttons display a shadow to indicate elevation. Primary Secondary Success Info Warn Help Danger Contrast Rounded # Rounded buttons have a circular border radius. Primary Secondary Success Info Warn Help Danger Contrast Text # Text buttons are displayed as textual elements. Primary Secondary Success Info Warn Help Danger Plain Raised Text # Text buttons can be displayed as raised for elevation. Primary Secondary Success Info Warn Help Danger Plain Outlined # Outlined buttons display a border without a background initially. Primary Secondary Success Info Warn Help Danger Contrast Icon Only # Buttons can have icons without labels. Badge # Buttons have built-in badge support with badge and badgeClass properties. Emails 2 Messages 2 Button Group # Multiple buttons are grouped when wrapped inside an element with ButtonGroup component. Save Delete Cancel Sizes # Button provides small and large sizes as alternatives to the standard. Small Normal Large Template # Custom content inside a button is defined as children. Accessibility # Screen Reader Button component renders a native button element that implicitly includes any passed prop. Text to describe the button is defined with the aria-label prop, if not present label prop is used as the value. If the button is icon only or custom templating is used, it is recommended to use aria-label so that screen readers would be able to read the element properly. <p-button icon="pi pi-check" aria-label="Submit" /> <p-button icon="pi pi-check" label="Submit" /> <p-button class="youtube p-0" aria-label="Youtube"> <i class="pi pi-youtube px-2"></i> <span class="px-4">Youtube</span> </p-button> Keyboard Support Key Function tab Moves focus to the button. enter Activates the button. space Activates the button.
